rt:var.name: Shift_i
rt:var.comment: Смещение видимых строк относительно начала списка

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Get_Vis() Dim i As Integer For i = 0 to 39 VisItem_s(i) = Item_s(i + Shift_i) Next i End Sub

Sub Reselect() Dim i As int For i = 0 to 39 If (i == (Cur_i - Shift_i)) Then ActiveItem_i(i) = True Else ActiveItem_i(i) = False End If Next i Slider.N_first = Shift_i + 1 Slider.N = Cur_i + 1 End Sub

Sub Clear_Items() Dim i As Integer For i = 0 To Total_i Item_s(i) = "" Next i For i = 0 To 39 VisItem_s(i) = "" ActiveItem_i(i) = false Next i Total_i = 0 Cur_i = -1 Shift_i = 0 Sel_s = "" Get_Vis() Reselect() Slider.Slider_pos() End Sub

Sub Add_Item(ByVal In_Str As String) If CheckDuplicated Then Dim i As int For i = 0 To (Total_i - 1) If (In_Str == Item_s(i)) Then Exit Sub End If Next i End If If (Total_i < 500) Then Item_s(Total_i) = In_Str Total_i = Total_i + 1 Get_Vis() Slider.Slider_pos() End If End Sub

Sub SelectVis_n (ByVal i As Integer) 'выбор из числа видимых If ((i < 0) || (i > 39)) Then Cur_i = -1 Sel_s = "" Get_Vis() ElseIf (VisItem_s(i) == "") || (i > (Total_i - 1)) Then Cur_i = -1 Sel_s = "" Get_Vis() Else Get_Vis() Sel_s = VisItem_s(i) Cur_i = i + Shift_i End If Reselect() End Sub
Sub Del_Sel_item() If (Cur_i == -1) Then Exit Sub End If Dim i As int Total_i = Total_i - 1 For i = Cur_i To (Total_i) Item_s(i) = Item_s(i + 1) Next i SelectVis_n(-1) End Sub
Function Get_i_item (ByVal i As Integer) As String Get_i_item = Item_s(i) End Function
rt:model.rt:event: Dim i As int For i = 0 to 39 VisItem_s(i) = "" Next i Slider.Slider_pos()
